brief:
Israeli warplanes struck the Mawasi area of Khan Younis in southern Gaza on Tuesday, killing one Palestinian and wounding at least nine others, including children, Shehab Wire reported. The attack targeted a residential zone in the coastal enclave's southern region.

The airstrike marked the latest in a series of strikes on populated areas of Gaza. Mawasi, a coastal district south of Khan Younis city proper, has faced repeated Israeli military operations throughout the conflict. The strike wounded civilians across multiple age groups, with children among those injured in the bombardment.
